title: Lodestone Guardian
summary: The Lodestone Guardians, nicknamed "rock heads" by Lok Lambert, are golem-like entities that serve as a defense mechanism for the Lodestone, near the Phoenix Volcano. Powered and controlled entirely by the Lodestone, they act as automated security units built specifically to protect the labyrinth chamber, with the Lodestone's anti-magic field completely preventing the use of Magic or Titans against them.

sections.heading: Appearance
sections.text:
The Lodestone Guardians are semi-sentient constructs capable of shifting between dormant and active states. When inactive, they are indistinguishable from ordinary chunks of rock. [The Dead Magic Island] 
* Standard Variant: The primary guardians are stocky human-sized, dark brown entities that patrol the outer maze corridors. [The Dead Magic Island]
* Leader Variant: A singular, much taller variant featuring a distinct reddish-tinted stone composition. This elite unit acts with increased aggression and commands the secondary wave of defenses inside the inner golden chamber.[The Dead Magic Island]

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
The Lodestone Guardians were encountered by [[Dante Vale]]'s team in an underground maze on an uninhabited Indonesian island. Though originally disguised as mere chunks of rock, the golems became activated when the team entered the second room in the maze. Due to the [[Lodestone]]'s anti-magic field, the team had to rely on [[Montehue]] to defeat them with his axes.

A second group of numerous guardians, including a larger leader variant, was encountered by the team in a large chamber with golden walls. As the team fled, [[Lok Lambert]] realized that the Lodestone was housed at the entrance of the maze. He eventually tripped one of the guardians to fall onto the Lodestone, breaking it and disabling the anti-magic field. This allowed Lok to [[Bladecall|summon]] the [[Willblade]] and destroy the Lodestone Guardians. {{source|The Dead Magic Island}}

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
Despite only being able to use brute force, the guardians could deal severe damage through their punches, and would combine with one another to crush or smother an opponent. They could easily be taken apart, however, by bladed weapons such as [[Montehue]]'s axes, and the [[Willblade]]. {{source|The Dead Magic Island}}

full_text:
The Lodestone Guardians, nicknamed "rock heads" by Lok Lambert, are golem-like entities that serve as a defense mechanism for the Lodestone, near the Phoenix Volcano. Powered and controlled entirely by the Lodestone, they act as automated security units built specifically to protect the labyrinth chamber, with the Lodestone's anti-magic field completely preventing the use of Magic or Titans against them.

== Appearance == 
The Lodestone Guardians are semi-sentient constructs capable of shifting between dormant and active states. When inactive, they are indistinguishable from ordinary chunks of rock. [The Dead Magic Island] 
* Standard Variant: The primary guardians are stocky human-sized, dark brown entities that patrol the outer maze corridors. [The Dead Magic Island]
* Leader Variant: A singular, much taller variant featuring a distinct reddish-tinted stone composition. This elite unit acts with increased aggression and commands the secondary wave of defenses inside the inner golden chamber.[The Dead Magic Island]

== History ==
The Lodestone Guardians were encountered by Dante Vale's team in an underground maze on an uninhabited Indonesian island. Though originally disguised as mere chunks of rock, the golems became activated when the team entered the second room in the maze. Due to the Lodestone's anti-magic field, the team had to rely on Montehue to defeat them with his axes.

A second group of numerous guardians, including a larger leader variant, was encountered by the team in a large chamber with golden walls. As the team fled, Lok Lambert realized that the Lodestone was housed at the entrance of the maze. He eventually tripped one of the guardians to fall onto the Lodestone, breaking it and disabling the anti-magic field. This allowed Lok to summon the Willblade and destroy the Lodestone Guardians. [The Dead Magic Island]

== Abilities ==
Despite only being able to use brute force, the guardians could deal severe damage through their punches, and would combine with one another to crush or smother an opponent. They could easily be taken apart, however, by bladed weapons such as Montehue's axes, and the Willblade. [The Dead Magic Island]
